resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA index lists longitude -108.04803, which falls outside Arizona. The Register gives -114.048327 (N 36.532447), near the Nevada border; the record already uses the Register figure. Both list register number US 1573, AZ 80, so the FFLA longitude is most likely a data-entry error. This is an inference, not confirmed by either source.

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR detail page gives history: 1962 build, 2022 registration, nominator, site description. The FFLA index gives standing status and the longitude conflict; the Peakbagging table gives the A condition code (good condition, capable of being staffed), which describes the building, not staffing. No staffing, fire, rental or visitor-rule source was found. Searches for Wade Luther and BLM Arizona Strip returned nothing specific to the lookout. A Whitney Pass Road near Whitney Pockets (aravada.com) is a road name, not linked to the lookout. The wchsutah.org Aravada Farm page failed with an SSL error and was not read. NHLR's cabin photos (courtesy of Wade Luther) are not added: their license is not stated. Facts omit height and visit fields because no source gives them.
